Looping in a couple quick pre-read items and one internal note.

Internal note for Logan/Karthik: Emma asked specifically about whether we can operate with egress locked to a NAT gateway + whitelist — we support that pattern (dedicated subnets + NAT). We should also surface an alternative: routed egress via a proxy appliance for customers that require mTLS to control flows.

For Emma/Arcadia — attaching two short reference docs (I'll drop links in the invite):
- KB: "Redwood VPC patterns for restricted egress" (1 page)
- KB: "KMS options: BYOK vs Redwood-managed" (1 page)

Agenda suggestion (30–45m):
1) 5m intros + objectives
2) 10–15m egress & network patterns (NAT, proxy, firewall rules)
3) 10–15m KMS patterns + key separation options
4) 5–10m follow-ups & next steps (evaluation cluster, audit evidence)

I can present the network slide; Karthik can handle KMS.

Ben Carter | Pre-sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
